programs.description: Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community.
Two struggling actors from Punjab who have the same name, Balwinder Singh, come to Mumbai and fall in love with the same woman.
Pehlwaan, a criminal, narrowly escapes a police encounter and uses a holy man's guise to hide. Though he soon amasses many followers, he continues to carry out his illegal activities.
Falsely accused of robbery and sent to prison for 12 years, a bank manager realises upon his return that a person whom he trusted had betrayed him.
Prem Mehra loses everything after one of his employees joins hands with his rapacious rival and the two plot against him. Later, his sons work together to retrieve their family's lost wealth.

After the death of his mother, Raju's father re-marries, but his stepmother is only after the family's money. When Raju eventually marries, his wife tries to make him realise what kind of woman his stepmother is.
Ruby ventures into the forest searching for a legendary tribe but encounters Tarzan and falls for him. However, her father and fiancé plot to capture him and sell him to the circus.
At an orphanage, Kailashnath identifies Vijay as his biological son and takes him home. Years later, a man named Ashok arrives and claims to be Kailashnath's real son.
Deepa, a young woman, meets Sanjay and falls in love with him. But when she goes to Bombay to look for a job, the arrival of a former lover puts her in a quandary.
An idealist elder brother lands in a dilemma after he misplaces his little sister's shoes. Unable to afford a new pair, the siblings agree to share the shoes, leading to several escapades.
A flood separates childhood friends Seema and Rajesh. Years later, when she reconciles with him and the two plan to get together, things go awry with the arrival of a mysterious woman.

The police are out on the hunt for a serial killer who targets beautiful women. Their luck changes when a woman who is in love with one of the suspects joins the search.
Things turn awry when a businessman, unaware of the truth, allows his pampered daughter to get engaged to the son of his old rival.
D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies.
Fueled by a deep desire for revenge, two young boys mature into strong-minded adults and set out to secure the justice denied to their father years ago.
The universe offers a Banjara tribe leader's daughter an opportunity to turn her doomed love story into a happily-ever-after with her soulmate.
When an expelled police inspector, an outlaw and a commissioner's son are implicated by a dealer, they unite to seek revenge and prove they are not culprits.
Dev, Vishal and Hrithik enter a singing competition. However, life is complicated for them as they face numerous obstacles in their personal lives which slowly bring out the best in them.
Subir, a singer, encourages his wife, Uma, to pursue a singing career. However, things take a turn when she becomes more popular than him.
The parents of an adopted child face issues of love, betrayal and custody when their daughter's birth mother arrives.
A woman who is blind struggles to come to terms with the apparent death of her first love and a new love who wants to help her move on with her life.

Karan Saxena, a police officer, arrests Sapna Mathur, a woman accused of killing his fellow constable. Things take a turn when Karan falls in love with her and helps her escape her death sentence.
Ashok, a fraudster, pretends to be rich and cheats several people. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with Seema.
Dev and Priya fall in love despite being engaged to their respective partners and decide to reunite after six months to get married. However, destiny has other plans for them.
Ram begins to suspect that his wife, Seeta, is having an affair with his brother, Amar. His doubts persist even after Amar gets married, creating problems within his family.
Mohanlal, a musician and a thief, robs rich people and distributes the money amongst the poor. However, things take a turn when he falls for Sunita, a wealthy man's daughter.
Destiny separates two lovers, Inder and Rama, and Inder marries Kamala. However, events take an unprecedented turn when Inder and Rama cross paths again years later.
Indian and Pakistani armies clash verbally, leading to a cricket match challenge where territorial pride hangs in the balance.
Raju and Urmila fall deeply in love and vow to reunite in India. However, complications arise when Raju agrees to pose as Sharmila's husband before her family.
Gangaram brings up his stepbrothers and borrows money to educate them. But, when he fails to repay and faces legal trouble, his brothers strive to help him.
Imran, a freelance photographer, meets Asiya, a mysterious woman, on his way to Alipur for an assignment. However, things take a turn when he repeatedly sees her and starts to question reality.

Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka.
When an ordinary man discovers crores in his account, he is thrown into a tangled mess of crime, impersonation and corrupt connections he never asked for.
Babu, who kills a man, is blackmailed by Bhagat into assuming the identity of a wealthy heir, Kundan, for his money. However, things get complicated when Babu falls in love with Kundan's sister.

Amar sets out to avenge his father's death but gets beaten to the brink of death. He returns to carry on his vendetta, only to be confronted by Vicky, a criminal-turned-policeman and his close friend.
Rahul looks after his spoilt nephews, Sunny and Vicky, and niece, Munni. When they go to a funfair, they meet Vyjayanti, who has run away from home, and decide to shelter her without Rahul's consent.

Rukhsar asks her best friend Nagma to marry her husband, Aslam, and mother a child for him when she is unable to do it herself. However, problems begin when Nagma's relatives cause discord among them.
Kishan, a dairy farmer, and Kabir, his brother, run into trouble when a local promoter decides to take over their land. When a corrupt inspector plays his part and kills Kabir, Kishan vows vengeance.
Raju and Madhu are forced apart by the latter's elder brothers, leading to increased distance between the two.
When Amba gets her son Rajendra arrested for sexually assaulting their servant's daughter, Rajendra's wife wreaks havoc in their lives as she vows to avenge him.
Two brothers who excel in boxing are separated in childhood and take different paths after their father, a police officer, is murdered by a gangster.

programs.showName: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programs.description: Haunted by the past, Vijay turns to crime, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest police officer. Fate pits them against each other when Ravi is sent to nab Vijay.
Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart.
A decorated school teacher's life is upended by devastating rumours, which ultimately lead to his death. His son Kundan now seeks vengeance.
A woman gets stuck in India when her flight to a foreign country gets delayed. While travelling in India, she meets Tony, a tour guide, and things take a turn when he falls in love with her.
In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.
Manisha, a wealthy woman, falls in love with Ajay, a middle-class man, who promises to marry her and settle down within three years. However, after the time period passes, he mysteriously disappears.
Returning from a foreign land, Pawan, a cold-hearted man, sets out to take his late brother's son back home. However, a string of events forces him to rethink his rigid principles.
Jai, a wealthy businessman in love with Tia, accidentally kills her husband in a car crash. After the accident Tia loses her memory and falls for Jai, who struggles with guilt.
Madhumita and Vishwanathan fall in love with each other but his father disapproves of the relationship as he wants his twin sons to marry two identical twins.

After the death of his parent, Kunal lives with his grandfather Shamsher. However, when he falls in love with Durga, Shamsher plans to separate them.
Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha.

Raj, an aspiring singer, rescues Pooja, the daughter of a wealthy man, from an accident. However, he soon finds himself in a web of complications when he falls in love with her best friend.
Anuradha's stepmother forces her to consume alcohol and she becomes an addict. After her father's death, she takes over the business and falls in love with Vikram, but her happiness is short-lived.
Som's mother sees her son's selection for a singing reality show as a second chance to fulfil her own dreams. However, complications arise when he faces a quick defeat.
A poet falls in love with a girl and later realises that she is terminally ill. Despite being aware of her condition, he decides to marry her and keep her happy.
Yash, Taj and Gaurav fall madly in love with Isha, a beautiful and charming woman. However, Isha is friendly with all three men, unaware of their feelings towards her.
